params.name: collection
params.description: Collection to fill; existing elements are replaced and new ones appended if the source array(s) are longer.

members.name: array
members.description: Array whose elements are copied into collection (or into propertyName's values, if passed).

members.name: propertyName
members.description: Object property name to fill with this array's values; if any propertyName is passed for one (array;propertyName) pair, it becomes mandatory for all of them, since collection is then built as an array of objects rather than of plain values.

overloads.semanticRole: Copies one or more arrays' elements into collection, either as plain collection elements or, when propertyName(s) are given, as a named property of each element object.
